title: Restructuring for outcomes: the operating model transformation
excerpt: Most organisations that say they want to be product-led have renamed their teams but not changed their thinking. This is a framework for making the transformation actually work — from squad design and outcome ownership to C-suite alignment.
lead: Product-led is not a team design. It is an operating model — and making it work requires the whole organisation to change, not just the product team.
lead_sub: A framework for the transformation, from first principles to the leadership contract that makes it stick.

title: The customisation trap: why saying yes gets easier and more expensive at the same time
excerpt: AI removed the old forcing function for saying no. Here's what accumulates in the gap — and what it looks like when a sophisticated buyer finds it.
lead: AI has made building software cheap. So cheap you can throw code away and rebuild it.
lead_sub: It sounds right, but it isn't.

title: You raised a Series C. Your product team is still operating at Series A.
excerpt: The scaling crack that almost nobody names before it breaks — and the five transitions that separate Series A operating habits from Series C expectations.
lead: I walked into a company and was given a list of commitments already made to the board. When I sat with the team delivering them, two things became clear: they weren't sure what they'd committed to, and nobody had defined what success looked like.
lead_sub: The scaling crack that almost nobody names before it breaks.
